description: Return one secret. By default only reports presence + version; pass reveal:true to decrypt the plaintext into this response (avoid unless the value is actually needed — prefer run_command). A revealed current value has its ${OTHER_SECRET} references expanded against this environment's own secrets; pass raw:true for the stored text instead. Pass `version` to read an earlier version instead of the current one (always as stored, never expanded).

app.description: application slug or id (or set via configure_project)

env.description: environment slug or id (a service token infers its own)

group.description: target a group environment instead of an app

org.description: organization slug or id (defaults to a lone org)

version.description: an earlier version from list_secret_versions (default: current)

name: get_secret
